candidate.title: A unidirectional mapping of ICD-8 to ICD-10 codes, for harmonized longitudinal analysis of diseases
candidate.abstract: Periodic revisions of the international classification of diseases (ICD) ensure that the classification reflects new practices and knowledge; however, this complicates retrospective research as diagnoses are coded in different versions. For longitudinal disease trajectory studies, a crosswalk is an essential tool and a comprehensive mapping between ICD-8 and ICD-10 has until now been lacking. In this study, we map all ICD-8 morbidity codes to ICD-10 in the expanded Danish ICD version. We mapped ICD-8 codes to ICD-10, using a many-to-one system inspired by general equivalence mappings such that each ICD-8 code maps to a single ICD-10 code. Each ICD-8 code was manually and unidirectionally mapped to a single ICD-10 code based on medical setting and context. Each match was assigned a score (1 of 4 levels) reflecting the quality of the match and, if applicable, a “flag” signalling choices made in the mapping. We provide the first complete mapping of the 8596 ICD-8 morbidity codes to ICD-10 codes. All Danish ICD-8 codes representing diseases were mapped and 5106 (59.4%) achieved the highest consistency score. Only 334 (3.9%) of the ICD-8 codes received the lowest mapping consistency score. The mapping provides a scaffold for translation of ICD-8 to ICD-10, which enable longitudinal disease studies back to and 1969 in Denmark and to 1965 internationally with further adaption.
candidate.authors: M. K. Pedersen, R. Eriksson, R. Reguant, C. Collin, H. Pedersen, F. Sørup, Christian Simon, A. Birch

panel.reason: ICD-8到ICD-10映射工具，支撑纵向疾病轨迹研究。
丹麦登记ICD映射工具，纵向轨迹研究基础设施。

extraction.data: 丹麦ICD-8/10分类及国家患者登记数据
extraction.results: 覆盖完整ICD及丹麦本地扩展，可连接1965年以来超半世纪医疗数据
extraction.limitations: 仅单向映射，未提供ICD-10回映射ICD-8
extraction.summary: 研究构建了ICD-8到ICD-10的单向映射，以支持跨版本长期疾病数据分析。方法基于丹麦官方ICD分类、WHO补充材料及丹麦国家患者登记编码频率，覆盖完整ICD及丹麦本地扩展。该映射可桥接ICD-8与ICD-10，使丹麦自1965年以来的高粒度医疗数据可进行纵向和跨代疾病轨迹研究。
